text:
**The evidence does not establish whether forest protection rules were violated.** It identifies a 0.6-hectare tree-cover loss in 2022, of which 0.5 hectares overlaps native forest on Uruguay’s 2021 forest map. The entire loss area was mapped as forest in the JRC’s 2020 reference.

The imagery does not establish the cause of the loss, whether it was authorized, or which protection rules applied. A compliance determination would require checking the applicable rules and any permits, and investigating the cause.
